mainEntity.name: Which Jaguar XJ engines can you rebuild?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on XJ engines including the 2.7 TDV6, 3.0 V6 diesel and 5.0 V8 petrol, with every job starting from a full assessment.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Jaguar XJ engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We provide a quote after assessing your XJ rather than a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a Jaguar XJ reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better option, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your XJ's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you have Jaguar XJ engines for sale in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source reconditioned XJ engines depending on availability. Contact us with your registration, and we will check suitable options for your car.

mainEntity.name: Does a knocking noise mean my XJ engine has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Knocking can have several causes, some minor and some serious. A proper inspection is needed before any conclusion is reached.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XJ engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once your engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my XJ from outside Essex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer UK-wide collection and delivery, so XJ owners can use our workshop wherever they are based in the country.
